label: Whatever bears the origin relation at a moment has received esse and is present then
paraphrase: OPEN analyst premise, attribution deferred (foundation of the origin relation on received esse): in every history of the model, whatever bears at moment t a real relation to something as to the principle of its being (OriginRelation.RelatedAt v x g t, the primitive of definition 7b28be97) has its esse received in some principle (DEF-ESSE-RECEIVED-IN) and is present at t. It is a necessary condition suggested by the order of subject to accident in ST I q.45 a.3 ad 3 (the creature is the subject of the relation and prior to it in being; passage fb7bd7bb, read; no claim is recorded); the priority itself is not typed, nor the priority that ad 3 assigns to the relation on the side of its term. It says nothing about the term of the relation.
